description: Data for: Geotechnical and Geomorphological Investigation of Rainfall Induced Shallow Landslide at Okeigbo, Ondo State, southwestern Nigeria is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley. Rainfall and spot height data in.DAT format. Stress diagrams in.eps format. Coverage: Nigeria. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley. Its tags are Meteorology, African Geology. The repository dates the deposit 2021; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial 3.0 Unported. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
